records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: API pagination — and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for the update, glad things are going well so far. On your open ticket: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you don't need to fetch everything at once — Tariq will confirm the details in that thread.

Whenever you're ready to set things up, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Want me to walk you through creating your first project on a short call this week?

Best,
Nadia
